episodes.name: Fellow Traveler
episodes.overview: A lunar misstep sends Roger on an unexpected detour to New Mexico.

episodes.name: The Professor and the Coach
episodes.overview: Hayley tries to help Roger write a book.

episodes.name: Viced Principal
episodes.overview: Steve and Principal Lewis get caught in a dangerous situation at the school. The rest of the family makes an adorable new friend.

episodes.name: The Pleasanting at Smith House
episodes.overview: Klaus and Jeff's friendship is threatened by Klaus's girlfriend from another realm.

episodes.name: Stretched Thin
episodes.overview: When Jeff finds out that the family thinks he makes terrible decisions, he decides to take a job selling stretchy leggings to prove them wrong.

episodes.name: Better on Paper
episodes.overview: When Stan discovers anonymous love letters written to Francine, he worries that this secret admirer could threaten their relationship.

episodes.name: Cow I Met Your Moo-ther
episodes.overview: The judgmental voice in Hayley's head makes it impossible for her to enjoy a girls' night with Nerfer and Danuta.

episodes.name: Stan Fixes a Shingle
episodes.overview: Francine insists that Steve let her help with his school project, Stan finally fixes that shingle, and the rest of the family goes on a quest to return Gallagher's mallet.

episodes.name: Saving Face
episodes.overview: In an attempt to maintain his "prime," Stan explores some cosmetic solutions that could not go worse.

episodes.name: Frantastic Voyage
episodes.overview: When Stan goes too far to keep his work friend away from Francine, she is forced to save her new "little" friend.

episodes.name: A Little Mystery
episodes.overview: Hayley makes Jeff get a friend to add some mystery to their relationship but gets more mystery than she bargained for. Francine attempts to grow the world's longest fingernails.

episodes.name: Don't You Be My Neighbor
episodes.overview: The Smiths get new neighbors! Meanwhile, Roger dreads having to be a little boy's kite for a day.

episodes.name: Productive Panic
episodes.overview: Francine becomes an overnight sensation when a famous art dealer discovers her homemade pottery.

episodes.name: Multiverse of American Dadness
episodes.overview: Hayley searches for a runaway Steve so they can go to a Shaggy concert.

episodes.name: Z.O.I.N.C.S.
episodes.overview: It's Halloween night and Stan is missing, so the Smith gang heads to the spooky, abandoned CIA headquarters to investigate.

episodes.name: A New Era for the Smith House
episodes.overview: Klaus house sits for the Smiths while they are away on vacation. Roger investigates the origin of powerful winds plaguing the Eastern Seaboard.

episodes.name: Between a Ring and a Hardass
episodes.overview: Social Services threatens to take Steve away from the family when someone files a complaint about Steve's chaotic home life.

episodes.name: Footprints
episodes.overview: Stan and Roger go on a mission to leave their mark on humanity. Jeff finally deals with the reality of losing his signature hat.

episodes.name: Steve, Snot, and the Quest for the Og 4LOCO
episodes.overview: To have a chance with a girl, Steve and Snot must track down a keg of 4Loko.

episodes.name: The Pink Sphinx Holds Her Hearts on the Turn
episodes.overview: Francine enters the strange and dangerous world of poker in order to learn how to hide her true feelings from Steve and Hayley.

episodes.name: A Little Extra Scratch
episodes.overview: Suspicious about Hayley's mysterious, newfound wealth, Francine decides to get to the bottom of it. Roger sets out to make Stan an internet celebrity.

episodes.name: Into the Jingleverse
episodes.overview: When Steve gives the family better Christmas gifts than Stan, Stan goes to great lengths to regain his title of "King of Presents."
